items.title: Intellect-2 Release: The First 32B Model Trained Through Globally Distributed RL
items.raw_content: We're excited to release INTELLECT-2, the first 32B parameter model trained via globally distributed reinforcement learning. Unlike traditional centralized training efforts, INTELLECT-2 trains a reasoning language model using fully asynchronous RL across a dynamic, heterogeneous swarm of compute contributors.
items.title_zh: Intellect-2 发布：首个通过全球分布式强化学习训练的 32B 模型
items.summary: Prime Intellect released INTELLECT-2, which it describes as the first 32B-parameter model trained through globally distributed reinforcement learning, using fully asynchronous RL across a dynamic, heterogeneous swarm of compute contributors.

items.title: LLMs are more persuasive than incentivized human persuaders
items.raw_content: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be highly persuasive, but when and why they outperform humans is still an open question. We compare the persuasiveness of two LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet and DeepSeek v3) against humans who had incentives to persuade, using an interactive, real-time conversational setting. We demonstrate that LLMs persuasive superiority is context-dependent: it depends on whether the persuasion attempt is truthful (towards the right answer) or deceptive (towards the wrong answer) and on the LLM model, and wanes over repeated interactions (unlike human persuasiveness). In our first large-scale experiment, humans vs LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) interacted with other humans who were completing an online quiz for a reward, attempting to persuade them toward a given (either correct or incorrect) answer. Claude was more persuasive than incentivized human persuaders both
items.title_zh: 大语言模型比受激励的人类说服者更具说服力
items.summary: In a large real-time conversation experiment, Claude 3.5 Sonnet proved more persuasive than incentivized human persuaders in some conditions; the advantage depended on whether the goal was truthful or deceptive and weakened over repeated interactions.

items.title_zh: Python 库根据使用方式即时生成代码
items.summary: autogenlib is a Python library that generates its own code on the fly based on how it is used, according to its GitHub repository.

items.summary: Databricks said it has agreed to acquire Neon, a serverless Postgres database company, aiming to bring more speed and flexibility to production workloads, according to the company's blog post.

items.title: Writing that changed how I think about programming languages
items.title_zh: 改变我编程语言观念的写作
items.summary: The author shares papers, blog posts and occasional videos about programming languages and compilers that reshaped how they think about the field. Some were so influential that they cannot recall how they reasoned about the topic beforehand.

items.title: Launch HN: Tinfoil (YC P25): Verifiable Privacy for Cloud AI
items.title_zh: Launch HN：Tinfoil（YC P25）为云端 AI 提供可验证隐私
items.summary: Tinfoil, a YC P25 startup, launched a cloud service that hosts open-source models such as Llama and DeepSeek R1 while guaranteeing zero data access and retention, so users need not trust the provider with private data.

items.summary: A developer with 15 years of MVP and SaaS experience recounts months of coding with LLMs and explains why he is going back to using his brain.

items.summary: A Mexican Navy ship hit the Brooklyn Bridge during a promotional tour, killing two people, according to The Guardian. The Mexican government said 22 crew members were injured, 11 of them critically, with nine in stable condition.

items.summary: The essay examines the technical, administrative, and social complexity of air traffic control, arguing that its peculiar, often accidental development and its reliance on hand-me-down military practices shaped the system.

items.title: Type-constrained code generation with language models
items.title_zh: 用语言模型进行类型约束的代码生成
items.summary: The paper introduces a type-constrained decoding approach that uses type systems, prefix automata and a search over inhabitable types to steer LLM code generation toward well-typed output.

items.summary: Octelium is a free and open-source, self-hosted zero-trust secure access platform that can act as a remote-access VPN, ZTNA platform, API/AI/MCP gateway, PaaS, ngrok alternative and homelab infrastructure.

items.title: Are LLMs complicated ethical dilemma analyzers?
items.title_zh: 大模型是复杂伦理困境的分析者吗？
items.summary: The paper introduces a benchmark of 196 real-world ethical dilemmas with expert opinions and evaluates GPT-4o-mini, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemini-1.5-Flash against expert and non-expert responses. It finds LLMs generally outperform non-expert humans on lexical and structural alignment, but all models struggle with historical grounding and nuanced resolution strategies.

items.title: MedCaseReasoning: Evaluating and learning diagnostic reasoning from clinical case reports
items.title_zh: MedCaseReasoning：从临床病例报告中评估与学习诊断推理
items.summary: The authors introduce MedCaseReasoning, an open-access dataset of 14,489 diagnostic question-and-answer cases paired with clinician-authored reasoning statements from medical case reports. They report that DeepSeek-R1 reaches only 48% 10-shot diagnostic accuracy and recalls 64% of clinician reasoning statements, while fine-tuning on the dataset improves diagnostic accuracy and reasoning recall by 29% and 41% relative on average.

items.title: Reasoning Large Language Model Errors Arise from Hallucinating Critical Problem Features
items.title_zh: 推理大模型的错误源于对关键问题特征的幻觉
items.summary: Testing o1-mini, o3-mini, DeepSeek-R1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Pro Preview, and Grok 3 Mini Beta on graph coloring, the authors find that reasoning LLMs often hallucinate graph edges not specified in the prompt, which explains many incorrect answers.

items.title: Asynchronous Multi-Object Tracking with an Event Camera
items.title_zh: 基于事件相机的异步多目标跟踪
items.summary: The paper presents AEMOT, an algorithm that detects and tracks multiple objects by processing raw event-camera events asynchronously. On a new Bee Swarm Dataset it reports precision and recall more than 37% above alternative event-based detection and tracking methods, and the code and dataset will be open sourced.

items.title: An evolutionary perspective on modes of learning in Transformers
items.title_zh: 从演化视角看 Transformer 的学习模式
items.summary: The authors use evolutionary biology to frame two learning strategies in Transformers, in-weight learning and in-context learning, and test how environmental stability and cue reliability shape which one dominates. In controlled sinusoid-regression and Omniglot tasks, stable environments favor in-weight learning while reliable cues favor in-context learning, with task-dependent transitions between the two.

items.title: Precision Proactivity: Measuring Cognitive Load in Real-World AI-Assisted Work
items.title_zh: 精准主动性：测量真实 AI 辅助工作中的认知负荷
items.summary: A study of 34 financial professionals using GPT-4o for a valuation task finds that extraneous cognitive load has the largest negative association with output quality, roughly three times that of intrinsic load.

items.title: Improving Energy Natural Gradient Descent through Woodbury, Momentum, and Randomization
items.title_zh: 利用 Woodbury、动量与随机化改进能量自然梯度下降
items.summary: The authors introduce techniques to make energy natural gradient descent for physics-informed neural networks more accurate and efficient, using the Woodbury formula, momentum, and randomization to reach the same L2 error up to 75 times faster.

items.title: mCLM: A Modular Chemical Language Model that Generates Functional and Makeable Molecules
items.title_zh: mCLM：生成功能性且可合成分子的模块化化学语言模型
items.summary: The authors propose mCLM, a modular chemical language model that tokenizes molecules as functional building blocks rather than atoms so that generated molecules are both functional and compatible with automated synthesis. The 3B-parameter model improves synthetic accessibility relative to seven leading generative AI methods, including GPT-5, and outperforms baselines on property scores and synthetic accessibility for 122 out-of-distribution medicines.

items.title: Model Performance-Guided Evaluation Data Selection for Effective Prompt Optimization
items.title_zh: 以模型性能引导评估数据选择，提升提示优化效果
items.summary: Researchers propose IPOMP, a two-stage method that selects evaluation data for prompt optimization using semantic clustering, boundary analysis and real-time model performance, reporting 1.6% to 5.3% effectiveness gains and at least 57% better stability on BIG-bench.
